overview:
Snow views in Sissu, Kasol's chill vibes and Manali's mountain madness: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** winter weekend leaves Delhi or Chandigarh at 8-9 PM (tentative) in an AC deluxe vehicle and gets you back by 7-8 AM on Day 4.

Day 1 is Manali sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road with café hopping, then dinner with a bonfire and light music. Day 2 heads to Solang Valley and on through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu for panoramic snow views, with adventure activities at your own cost. Day 3 covers Manikaran Sahib and its hot sulphur springs and the Kasol market before a late evening departure. Two hotel nights in Manali, 4 meals, travel and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), and you reserve with a ₹3,000 advance.

itinerary.title: Manali exploration
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road, with café hopping.
Back to the hotel.
Dinner served with a bonfire and light music. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Sissu
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Head to Solang Valley, then on to Sissu through the Atal Tunnel for adventure activities (own cost) and panoramic snow views.
Back to Manali for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kasol, Manikaran and departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Leave for Manikaran, known for Manikaran Sahib and its natural hot sulphur springs.
Explore the Kasol market, then depart late in the evening.
Reach back by 7-8 AM the next day.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Pickup is from Delhi or Chandigarh at 8-9 PM (tentative), in an AC deluxe vehicle, with a dinner halt on the way (not included). The exact pickup point is shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You reach Manali the next morning and are back by 7-8 AM on Day 4.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Sissu & Kasol trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates, ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,000 on triple sharing and ₹7,500 on double sharing. Christmas and New Year batches (departures from 24 to 30 December) cost ₹8,000 quad, ₹8,500 triple and ₹9,000 double. 5% GST is extra.

The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use. Bookings can't be transferred: only the names given at confirmation may travel.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Nights are cold, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, waterproof shoes with good grip and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
